# Stair socket spec

**Generated by `scripts/stair-socket.cjs` — do not edit by hand.**
Regenerate with `npm run build:interior` after any layout change.

The generated staircase in the interior GLBs is a **collision proxy**, not
artwork. Build the art asset to the dimensions below and it will drop onto the
proxy exactly. Do not reshape these to suit a model — collision, eye height and
floor transitions are all driven from them.

## Shaft

| | Value |
|---|---|
| Shaft footprint (world X) | 298.678 → 300.978 (2.3 wide) |
| Shaft footprint (world Z) | 2.99 → 6.49 (3.5 deep) |
| West flight, X band | 298.678 → 299.728 (1.05 wide) |
| East flight, X band | 299.928 → 300.978 (1.05 wide) |
| Newel gap between flights | 0.2 |
| Turn / half-landing Z | 5.29 → 6.49 (1.2 deep) |
| House origin | X0 = 300, front wall at Z = 0 |

## Flight

| | Value |
|---|---|
| Rise per flight | 1.6 |
| Run per flight | 2.3 |
| Pitch | 34.8° |
| Floor-to-floor | 3.2 |
| Flights per storey | 2 (switchback, half-landing between) |

## Runs, per storey

World Y. `bottomCoord`/`topCoord` are Z values and are **not** sorted —
a switchback's return leg runs toward −Z, so its topCoord is the smaller number.

| id | floor | X band | Z: bottom → top | Y: bottom → top |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `basement-flight-a` | basement | 298.678 → 299.728 | 2.99 → 5.29 | -3.2 → -1.6 |
| `basement-half-landing` | basement | 298.678 → 300.978 | 5.29 → 6.49 | -1.6 → -1.6 *(flat landing)* |
| `basement-flight-b` | basement | 299.928 → 300.978 | 5.29 → 2.99 | -1.6 → 0 |
| `ground-flight-a` | ground | 298.678 → 299.728 | 2.99 → 5.29 | 0 → 1.6 |
| `ground-half-landing` | ground | 298.678 → 300.978 | 5.29 → 6.49 | 1.6 → 1.6 *(flat landing)* |
| `ground-flight-b` | ground | 299.928 → 300.978 | 5.29 → 2.99 | 1.6 → 3.2 |
| `second-flight-a` | second | 298.678 → 299.728 | 2.99 → 5.29 | 3.2 → 4.8 |
| `second-half-landing` | second | 298.678 → 300.978 | 5.29 → 6.49 | 4.8 → 4.8 *(flat landing)* |
| `second-flight-b` | second | 299.928 → 300.978 | 5.29 → 2.99 | 4.8 → 6.4 |

## Rules for the art asset

- Tread nosings must sit **on** the proxy surface, not above or below it. The
  player's eye is placed 1.7 above the interpolated surface height, so a model
  sitting proud of the proxy will read as walking through the treads.
- Railings, newels, balusters and stringers are **entirely art** — nothing in
  collision reads them, so they can be as ornate as the budget allows. They may
  overhang the shaft, but not into the walkable band of either flight.
- The shaft is a hole in every floor slab it passes through. A finished
  underside/soffit is the asset's job; the generator emits none.
- Model at world coordinates, or at origin with the offsets above applied on
  placement — either is fine, but state which.
